snippet.title: Happy’s Humble Burger Cult - Trial by Fryer Update Trailer
snippet.description:
Play now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453910/Happys_Humble_Burger_Cult/

Two new restaurants and Trial by Fryer, a new team-based PvP mode, were added to the co-op cooking horror Happy’s Humble Burger Cult, available now on Steam! Face off against the enemy team in a surreal cooking show, sabotage their kitchen, fight for ingredients, and become the best team of chefs in Trial by Fryer.
